A Cargo Pad is a launch pad with a hold. Build a 3x3 pad around it, pipe fuel and items in, and place a second one where the goods should land.
gui.nerospace.star_guide.step.cargo_rock: A Cargo Rocket needs no pilot. Deploy it on a Cargo Pad, pick the destination pad in the GUI and press Launch — or let the schedule do it.
gui.nerospace.star_guide.step.first_frei: Your first delivery arrives on the far pad with nobody at either end. Pipes take it from there. Flights survive a server restart.

item.nerospace.cargo_rocket.deployed_nee: Cargo rocket deployed. This pad reads as Tier %s — a cargo rocket needs a Tier %s pad (a full 3x3 around the Cargo Pad) to launch.

chapter.nerospace.starfarers_log.title: Starfarer's Log
quest.nerospace.starfarers_log.first_ner: You smelted your first Nerosium ingot. Every voyage starts with a single bar of strange metal.
quest.nerospace.starfarers_log.grinder_o: You built a Nerosium Grinder. Meteor rock now yields its secrets to your machines.
quest.nerospace.starfarers_log.industria: You brought industry to your corner of the world. The hum of machines will carry you skyward.
quest.nerospace.starfarers_log.launch_re: You assembled a launch pad and your first rocket. The countdown is yours to begin.
quest.nerospace.starfarers_log.reached_o: You slipped the bonds of the Overworld and reached orbit. The stars are no longer a ceiling.
quest.nerospace.starfarers_log.station_v: You set foot aboard an orbital station. A harbour among the stars, built by your own hands.
quest.nerospace.starfarers_log.breathe_e: You sealed yourself into a full oxygen suit. Vacuum is just another weather now.
quest.nerospace.starfarers_log.first_col: You founded a colony beyond the sky. Somewhere out there, people now call a new place home.
quest.nerospace.starfarers_log.greenxert: You landed on Greenxertz, the first alien world to feel your boots.
quest.nerospace.starfarers_log.cindara.d: You braved the heat of Cindara and carried home a shard of cindrite.
quest.nerospace.starfarers_log.glacira.d: You crossed the frozen wastes of Glacira and returned with glacite in hand.
quest.nerospace.starfarers_log.deep_spac: You pushed past every known horizon into deep space. The log is yours; the stars remember.
quest.nerospace.starfarers_log.stalker_h: You faced down five Xertz Stalkers and lived to write about it.
quest.nerospace.starfarers_log.freighter: You built a cargo rocket. Trade routes between worlds are now within reach.
quest.nerospace.starfarers_log.alien_rel: You recovered an alien core from the wreckage of a fallen meteor. Someone was here before you.
quest.nerospace.starfarers_log.first_fre: Your first cargo flight touched down and unloaded without you at either pad. The supply line is open.
quest.nerospace.starfarers_log.terraform: You stood on dead ground your Terraformer has taken root in. The first stage of a living world.
quest.nerospace.starfarers_log.living_wo: You walked on ground you made fully living: hydrated, weathered and green. A world is breathing because of you.
quest.nerospace.starfarers_log.hundred_f: Freight on this world has crossed a hundred deliveries. The pads never sleep.
message.nerospace.hook.star_guide_hint: Star Guide hint — your next step is in %s: %s
message.nerospace.hook.star_guide_comple: Star Guide hint — you have completed every step. The stars are yours.
message.nerospace.hook.oxygen_top_up: Oxygen topped up: your tank has been refilled.
